mapper.select: SELECT * FROM all_mail_data a WHERE a.start_date <= NOW() AND a.end_date >= NOW()

SELECT * FROM all_mail_data a LEFT JOIN user_mail_data b ON a.all_mail_unique = b.all_mail_unique WHERE a.start_date <= NOW() AND a.end_date >= NOW() AND a.seq = #{seq} AND b.user_uuid = #{user_uuid} GROUP BY a.seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_mail_data ( user_uuid, all_mail_unique, reward_unique, mail_title, mail_content, mail_sender, mail_start_date, mail_end_date, mail_note, use_yn, ins_date, ins_ip, ins_machine ) VALUES ( #{user_uuid}, #{all_mail_unique}, #{reward_unique}, #{mail_title}, #{mail_content}, #{mail_sender}, Now(), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY), #{mail_note}, 'Y', Now(), #{ins_ip}, #{ins_machine} )
mapper.select: SELECT seq, reward_unique, mail_title, mail_content, mail_sender, mail_start_date, mail_end_date FROM user_mail_data WHERE user_uuid = #{user_uuid} AND use_yn = 'Y' AND mail_start_date <= NOW() AND mail_end_date >= NOW() ORDER BY ins_date asc
SELECT use_yn FROM user_mail_data WHERE user_uuid = #{user_uuid} AND seq = #{seq} AND use_yn = 'Y' AND mail_start_date <= NOW() AND mail_end_date >= NOW() ORDER BY ins_date asc
